attribution: Wikipedia contributors; adapted national party-vote tables. Official results separately attributed to the Electoral Commission.

method.scope: National party-vote tables, including published internal polls, in the last Wikipedia revision before local election-day midnight. Excludes electorate and preferred-prime-minister tables. Coverage is source-table coverage, not a claim that an omitted party was never measured.
method.selection: Latest documented fieldwork end, then publication upper bound. Single dates that may be release dates are ineligible; month-only fieldwork uses a labelled conservative month-end upper bound. Internal polls are not necessarily representative of all polls commissioned.
method.publication: published_by is the pinned revision timestamp: public no later than this instant, not an asserted original release time.
method.revisions: Use only values in the last pre-cutoff revision; later additions, corrections and extra decimal precision are excluded. Wikipedia template output is not evidence; retained revision wikitext is authoritative.
method.arithmetic: Poll shares are exact decimal strings. Official shares, signed errors and MAE are exact rational numbers with decimal-string integer numerator and denominator, because vote-count division usually repeats. No intermediate rounding.
method.rounding: Display percentage points to 2 decimal places, ROUND_HALF_UP, only after exact arithmetic.
method.naming: Reuse nat/lab/grn/act/nzf/tpm/opp and pollster IDs. verian groups the 1 News Colmar Brunton/Kantar Public/Verian series; preserve source labels. Historical parties and other pollsters retain explicit IDs; UMR is not merged with Talbot Mills.
method.comparison: Compare only individually reported parties with official party votes. Never compare Others or infer a blank as zero. Unequal coverage does not support a ranking.

sources.reviewer: Codex: transcribed and checked against the pinned national tables; supervisor review remains external to this snapshot.
sources.notes: Gzip preserves the acquired API response bytes; sha256 covers decompressed bytes. Raw revision wikitext is authoritative, including pre-election precision. No post-election poll corrections accepted.
